name.description: Name of the storage zone and pull zone.

outputDir.description: Build output directory that gets deployed.

domain.description: Custom domain. Added with a free SSL certificate on deploy; removing it here does not remove it from bunny.net.

aliases.description: Hostnames, added with a free SSL certificate, that 301-redirect to domain. Requires domain and must not repeat it.

region.description: Main storage region. Cannot be changed after init.

replicationRegions.description: Storage replication regions. bunny.net does not allow removing them.

geoZones.description: CDN delivery regions of the pull zone.

trailingSlash.description: Redirect extensionless paths to their trailing slash form (always), away from it (never), or not at all (ignore). Defaults to always, or ignore in SPA mode.

redirects.description: Redirects in the shape of [[redirects]] in netlify.toml. Each becomes an edge rule; the first match wins. {"from": "/*", "to": "/index.html", "status": 200} turns on SPA mode instead.

from.description: Path to match, such as /blog/:slug or /docs/*, or a full URL to match one host.

to.description: Target path or URL. :name and :splat insert what the placeholder and * matched.

status.description: 301 or 302. 303 and 307 are sent as 302, 308 as 301. Only 200 for SPA mode.

force.description: Accepted for Netlify compatibility. Every redirect behaves as forced.

query.description: Not supported: the redirect is skipped with a warning.

conditions.description: Only Country is supported. Other conditions skip the redirect with a warning.

headers.description: Response headers in the shape of [[headers]] in netlify.toml. Each entry becomes an edge rule; when several match, the last one wins.

for.description: Path to match. * matches any characters, also inside a segment, such as /assets/*.css.

values.description: Header names and values. Basic-Auth, CDN-* and headers bunny.net sets itself are skipped with a warning.
